experience.adrenaline: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Excitement and visceral exhilaration during viewing.
experience.tension: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Suspense, dread, or anticipation of an uncertain outcome.
experience.fear: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Fright or horror experienced, independently of horror genre membership.
experience.perceived_threat: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Sense that characters face harm, including harm never shown.
experience.romantic_feeling: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Romantic affection or longing evoked in the viewer.
experience.sensuality: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Erotic atmosphere or sexual tension, independently of explicit sexual depiction.
experience.warmth: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Affectionate, kind, or emotionally welcoming tone.
experience.wholesomeness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Reassurance through care, kindness, and emotional safety.
experience.wonder: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Awe, amazement, or fascination with discovery.
experience.pathos: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Acute pity, sorrow, or tragic emotional impact.
experience.uncanniness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Unease from the strangely familiar or almost natural.
experience.catharsis: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Emotional release after accumulated tension or feeling.
experience.nostalgia: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Longing for a remembered or imagined past evoked by the work; not release age.
experience.hopefulness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Optimistic outlook or belief in positive possibilities.
experience.bleakness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Pessimistic, despairing, or nihilistic outlook.
experience.emotional_intensity: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Overall strength of emotional engagement, regardless of positive or negative tone.
experience.stress: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Sustained pressure, discomfort, or anxiety experienced during viewing.
experience.uplift: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Encouragement, joy, or improved spirits evoked.
experience.thought_provocation: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Invitation to reflect on ideas, ethics, or interpretations beyond the immediate plot.
experience.playfulness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Light, mischievous, or freely inventive tone.
experience.sentimentality: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Overt appeal to tender feelings and emotional attachment.
experience.emotional_restraint: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Understated expression and withholding of overt emotional display.
experience.bittersweetness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Positive and painful feelings intertwined rather than merely appearing separately.
experience.absurdity: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Experience of incongruity, illogic, or strangeness, whether humorous or unsettling.
experience.escapism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Immersion away from everyday concerns; not limited to fantasy settings.
experience.wish_fulfillment: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Invitation to imagine desired powers, relationships, status, or ways of life.
experience.tranquility: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Calm, restful or meditative feeling evoked; not merely absence of tension.
experience.indignation: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Moral outrage or righteous anger evoked in the viewer; distinct from anger depicted by characters.
experience.disgust: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Revulsion evoked, independently of comic gross-out, frightening threat or grotesque visual style.
humor.overall: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Overall amount and strength of comedy, independently of individual humor styles.
humor.situational: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor from circumstances, misunderstandings, and complications; no episodic-format requirement.
humor.wit_wordplay: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor from verbal cleverness, puns, or linguistic ambiguity.
humor.physical: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor from bodily action, slapstick, or visual physical mishaps.
humor.cringe: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor from embarrassment or uncomfortable social situations.
humor.absurdist: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor from nonsense, illogic, or bizarre juxtapositions.
humor.satire: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humorous critique of institutions, behavior, or social conventions.
humor.parody: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humorous imitation of a recognizable work, genre, or style.
humor.dark: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor about death, suffering, taboo, or tragedy.
humor.running_gags: integer 0–10 (frequency) — Recurring jokes whose repetition or variation creates humor.
humor.meta: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor about storytelling, production, audiences, or the work itself.
humor.deadpan: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor delivered with apparent seriousness or minimal emotional reaction.
humor.gross_out: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Humor relying on bodily fluids, disgust, or vulgar physical material.
themes.crime: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Criminal acts and their consequences as subject matter.
themes.mystery: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Uncovering an important unknown as a central concern.
themes.war: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Armed conflict and its human or societal consequences.
themes.politics: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Governance, political institutions, and struggles for political power.
themes.radicalization: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A depicted process of adopting increasingly extreme ideological commitments or endorsing extremist action for an ideology. A criminal career, moral deterioration, pursuit of wealth or power, rebellion, or an already-extremist character appearing does not by itself establish ideological radicalization. Assess the process, not merely the resulting violence or group membership.
themes.family: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Family bonds, conflict, obligations, and belonging.
themes.psychology: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Mental processes, internal conflict, or perception as subject matter.
themes.entertainment_industry: integer 0–10 (centrality) — The business and practice of entertainment and celebrity.
themes.social_critique: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Examination or criticism of social arrangements and norms.
themes.class: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Social class, economic inequality, and mobility.
themes.capitalism: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Economic systems organized around capital, profit, and ownership.
themes.consumerism: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Exploration or critique of acquiring goods, consumption, brands, or possessions as a source of identity, status, or fulfillment. Distinct from capitalism as an economic system; buying or using a product alone is insufficient.
themes.technological_change: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Exploration of societal or personal effects of technological development, adoption, or displacement, including effects on work, relationships, institutions, and identity. Gadget presence, advanced technology, or science alone is insufficient.
themes.human_nature: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Explicit thematic exploration of what humans are like: capacities, impulses, morality, cooperation, cruelty, or tensions between nature and social conditioning. Ordinary human characters, emotion, or drama alone is insufficient; not a synonym for personal identity, consciousness, or existential meaning.
themes.faith_and_spirituality: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Religious belief, spiritual practice, or metaphysical meaning.
themes.business: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Commercial organizations, enterprise, and work decisions.
themes.finance: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Money management, financial systems, investing, or debt.
themes.environment: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Relationships between human activity and ecosystems.
themes.science: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Scientific inquiry and its ideas, practice, or consequences.
themes.popular_culture: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Popular media, celebrity, fandom, or shared cultural trends.
themes.survival: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Meeting essential needs or overcoming threats to continued life.
themes.adventure: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Exploration, risk, and discovery outside ordinary life.
themes.hacking: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Intrusion into or manipulation of computer systems.
themes.artificial_intelligence: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Artificial agents and their interaction with the world.
themes.consciousness: integer 0–10 (centrality) — The nature of subjective experience and personhood.
themes.identity: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Formation, discovery, concealment, or change of personal identity.
themes.existential_meaning: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Purpose, freedom, mortality, and the meaning of existence.
themes.grief: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Responses to loss and mourning.
themes.trauma: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Lasting effects of overwhelming or harmful experiences.
themes.recovery: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Processes of rebuilding after trauma, illness, or crisis.
themes.mental_health: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Mental health conditions, care, and lived experience.
themes.addiction: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Dependency and its effects on people and relationships.
themes.addiction_recovery: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Attempts to overcome dependency and maintain recovery.
themes.trust_and_betrayal: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Reliance on others, deception, and broken trust.
themes.coming_of_age: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Development toward adult identity, agency, or responsibility.
themes.coming_out: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Disclosure or recognition of LGBTQ identity in a social context.
themes.sexuality: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Sexual identity, desire, and their social meaning.
themes.gender_identity: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Gender identity and its personal or social implications. Distinct from social expectations about gender roles and from sexism; do not infer identity from conformity to or rejection of a role.
themes.gender_roles: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Exploration of social expectations, norms, or performances of masculinity, femininity, and gendered roles. Distinct from a person's gender identity and from sexism as discrimination; either may coexist without implying the other.
themes.immigration: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Migration across borders and the experience of settlement.
themes.displacement: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Loss of home or community through conflict, coercion, or other forces.
themes.gentrification: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Neighborhood change associated with investment and displacement.
themes.surveillance: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Monitoring, privacy, and control through observation.
themes.disease_and_pandemics: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Population-level disease transmission, epidemics, pandemics or public-health response matter as subjects. Personal diagnosis, dying and care are assessed separately as illness_and_dying.
themes.climate_change: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Climate processes, human causes, or consequences.
themes.inherited_wealth: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Inheritance, dynastic wealth, and intergenerational economic advantage.
themes.social_media: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Online social platforms and their effects on life.
themes.public_shaming: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Public condemnation, reputational punishment, or social exclusion.
themes.justice: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Fairness, accountability, punishment, and redress.
themes.guilt: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Responsibility, remorse, and moral burden.
themes.forgiveness: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Letting go of blame or reconciling after harm.
themes.loyalty: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Commitment to people, groups, or principles under pressure.
themes.belonging: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Acceptance, community, and finding a place among others.
themes.loneliness: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Isolation and unmet desire for connection.
themes.ambition: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Pursuit of achievement, status, or recognition.
themes.obsession: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Consuming fixation and its consequences.
themes.labor: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Working conditions, worker identity, organizing, and exploitation.
themes.colonialism: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Colonial domination, resistance, and its legacies.
themes.racism: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Racial discrimination and its personal or structural consequences.
themes.sexism: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Discrimination or domination based on sex or gender.
themes.caregiving: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Responsibility for another person's everyday support and wellbeing.
themes.parenthood: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Becoming or being a parent and its consequences.
themes.aging: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Later life, changing capacities, and social experiences of aging.
themes.midlife: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Reassessment and transitions in middle adulthood.
themes.retirement: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Leaving paid work and adjusting to life afterward.
themes.early_adulthood: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Independence, work, and relationships in early adult life.
themes.education: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Learning, schooling, and educational institutions.
themes.artistic_creation: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Making art and the motivations or struggles involved.
themes.persuasion_and_propaganda: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Shaping public or interpersonal belief through persuasion, spin, PR, advertising, propaganda or disinformation is a subject of the work; do not label the work itself propaganda from this score.
themes.illness_and_dying: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Personal illness, diagnosis, living with illness, dying or end-of-life care is a subject; distinct from population-level epidemics.
themes.corruption: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Abuse of entrusted public, organizational or professional power for private gain is a subject; not all crime or ambition is corruption.
narrative_engines.investigation: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Characters gather evidence to explain an event or identify responsibility.
narrative_engines.pursuit: integer 0–10 (centrality) — An extended chase or hunt organizes the story.
narrative_engines.rescue: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Saving someone from captivity or danger organizes the story.
narrative_engines.escape: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Getting out of confinement or an unsafe situation organizes the story.
narrative_engines.quest: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A journey toward a defined objective organizes the story.
narrative_engines.competition: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A contest with rivals and an outcome organizes the story.
narrative_engines.relationship_developme: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Changes in a relationship organize the story.
narrative_engines.everyday_life: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Ordinary routines and small events organize the story.
narrative_engines.survival: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Remaining alive under threatening conditions organizes the story.
narrative_engines.heist: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Planning, carrying out, or dealing with a theft organizes the story.
narrative_engines.espionage: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Secret intelligence gathering or covert state operations organize the story.
narrative_engines.military_operation: integer 0–10 (centrality) — An organized military mission structures the story.
narrative_engines.legal_case: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Court proceedings, formal adjudication or preparation for a legal case organize the story. Legislative debate or a political committee hearing alone belongs to political_struggle.
narrative_engines.political_struggle: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Pursuit or exercise of political power structures the story.
tropes.underdog_rise: integer 0–10 (centrality) — An initially disadvantaged character gains standing or succeeds against stronger opposition. Spoiler-sensitive.
tropes.revenge: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Retaliation for a perceived wrong drives an arc. Spoiler-sensitive.
tropes.fall_from_grace: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A character loses status, reputation, or moral standing. Spoiler-sensitive.
tropes.redemption: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A character attempts to make amends or change after wrongdoing. Spoiler-sensitive.
relationships.romantic_development: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Formation or deepening of a romantic relationship matters to the story.
relationships.established_couple: integer 0–10 (centrality) — An ongoing romantic partnership matters to the story; former partners or separated co-parents alone belong to breakup_or_divorce or parent_child.
relationships.breakup_or_divorce: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Ending a partnership matters to the story.
relationships.partner_bereavement: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Loss of a romantic partner matters to the story.
relationships.love_triangle: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Competing romantic attachments among three people matter to the story.
relationships.forbidden_romance: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A romantic relationship faces a consequential social or institutional prohibition.
relationships.friendship: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Non-romantic bonds of friendship matter to the story.
relationships.mentor_mentee: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Guidance and learning between mentor and mentee matter to the story.
relationships.rivalry: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Competition or mutual opposition between characters matters to the story.
relationships.forced_proximity: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Circumstances oblige characters to remain close or share space.
relationships.adversaries_cooperate: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Characters with genuinely opposing goals cooperate in a consequential shared undertaking; friendly peers in different industries are not automatically adversaries.
relationships.found_family: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Chosen bonds serve a family-like role in the story.
relationships.family_conflict: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Sustained conflict or harmful dysfunction within a family matters to the story.
relationships.intergenerational: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Relationships across generations matter to the story.
relationships.generational_trauma: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Trauma transmitted or repeated across generations matters to the story.
relationships.parent_child: integer 0–10 (centrality) — The relationship between parent and child matters to the story.
relationships.siblings: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Sibling relationships matter to the story.
relationships.caregiver_dependent: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Care and dependence between characters matter to the story.
relationships.human_animal_companionship: integer 0–10 (centrality) — An emotional bond between a person and animal matters to the story.
relationships.coercive_relationship: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Manipulation, coercion, or control within an interpersonal relationship matters to the story. Systematic control of members by a group is assessed separately as coercive_group_control; neither automatically implies the other.
relationships.coercive_group_control: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A group or leader systematically controls members through intimidation, isolation, dependency, punishment, or suppression of autonomy. Distinct from interpersonal coercion, voluntary discipline, secrecy, and radicalization; any of these may coexist but does not imply group control.
characters.ensemble: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Several focal characters share narrative attention and agency.
characters.antihero: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A focal character departs substantially from conventional heroic ethics or behavior.
characters.morally_ambiguous_cast: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Moral ambiguity among multiple major characters matters to the work.
characters.transformation_arc: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Substantial change in a focal character's beliefs, identity, or behavior.
characters.intellectual_problem_solver: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A focal character's reasoning or specialized intellectual ability drives events.
characters.detective_lead: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A focal character acts as an investigator or detective.
characters.workplace_team: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A team formed through work is a central social unit.
characters.family_business: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A family-run business is a central social unit.
characters.unaccompanied_children: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Children without their usual caregivers form a central social situation.
characters.teen_peer_group: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Teenage friendships and peer-group dynamics form a central social situation.
characters.clandestine_groups: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A secret society or organized group whose membership, meetings, activities, or aims are deliberately concealed. Secrecy is the defining feature, not coercion or extremist ideology; a secret held by one person, an ordinary private friendship, or crime alone is insufficient.
world.advanced_technology: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Technology substantially beyond the work's contemporary baseline shapes its world.
world.magic: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Supernatural abilities or forces understood as magic shape the world.
world.simulation: integer 0–10 (centrality) — An artificial computed or explicitly constructed simulated reality is an important layer of the depicted world. A physically staged environment, television studio, theatrical set, surveillance broadcast, social deception, dream, or the mere fact that a work is fiction does not qualify. Score the simulated reality, not a character being deceived about a physical environment.
world.virtual_reality: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Characters experience an interactive digitally mediated environment. A physical set, surveillance broadcast or deception alone is not virtual reality.
world.parallel_worlds: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Coexisting alternative realities matter to the world.
world.time_travel: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Movement across time outside ordinary chronological passage matters to the world.
world.time_loop: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Repetition of a period of time matters to the world or narrative.
world.dystopian_society: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Oppressive or deeply dysfunctional social arrangements define the world.
world.post_apocalyptic: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Life after a civilization-scale catastrophe defines the world.
world.spacefaring: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Travel or life beyond Earth is consequential to the world.
world.robots: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Embodied artificial machines functioning as agents matter to the world; not synonymous with AI.
world.myth_and_folklore: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Recognizable mythological or folkloric traditions shape the world.
world_treatment.scientific_rigor: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Attention to scientific constraints and explanatory consistency; not an inverse of speculative freedom.
world_treatment.speculative_freedom: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Freedom to use speculative premises without scientific elaboration.
world_treatment.worldbuilding_depth: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Detail and interconnection in the world's institutions, history, and rules.
world_treatment.magic_rule_detail: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Elaboration of rules and constraints governing magic.
world_treatment.everyday_realism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Attention to plausible ordinary behavior and material conditions, independently of era.
world_treatment.magical_realism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Impossible or supernatural events are treated as ordinary within an otherwise everyday world; distinct from an explicitly elaborated magic system.
storytelling.plot_velocity: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Rate at which consequential plot events occur.
storytelling.gradual_development: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Deliberate accumulation of character, relationships, or tension over time; can coexist with rapid action.
storytelling.intrigue: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Strength of curiosity about what happens or what is concealed.
storytelling.plot_complexity: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Interdependence of events, causes, and plot threads.
storytelling.interpretive_ambiguity: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Extent to which meaning or events support multiple interpretations.
storytelling.twist_frequency: integer 0–10 (frequency) — Recurrence of major reversals or revelations over the work.
storytelling.twist_impact: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Extent to which revelations alter understanding or expectations.
storytelling.multiple_timelines: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of distinct temporal strands; not necessarily time travel.
storytelling.multiple_viewpoints: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Distribution of storytelling across distinct character perspectives.
storytelling.unreliable_narration: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Uncertainty created by an unreliable narrator or viewpoint.
storytelling.unreliable_reality: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Uncertainty about which presented events or reality layers are real.
storytelling.self_reference: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Attention to the work's own storytelling or construction.
storytelling.fourth_wall_breaking: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Explicit acknowledgment of the audience or of the work as a presented fiction, including direct address. Voiceover alone is not sufficient.
storytelling.voiceover: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of spoken narration over images outside ordinary scene dialogue.
storytelling.dream_sequences: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of dreams or hallucinations as presented sequences.
storytelling.observational_mode: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Attention to behavior and environments without strong explanatory or plot intervention.
storytelling.slice_of_life: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Emphasis on ordinary experience rather than extraordinary plot escalation.
storytelling.exposition_load: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Amount of explanatory information the viewer must absorb.
storytelling.information_withholding: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Deliberate delay in supplying information needed to understand events.
storytelling.philosophical_inquiry: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Explicit exploration of philosophical questions.
storytelling.formal_challenge: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Departure from familiar formal conventions that demands adaptation.
storytelling.didacticism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — How explicitly the work states, teaches or argues a message; independent of intellectual stimulation or whether the viewer agrees.
storytelling.confined_setting: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Concentration of the work within a single location or tightly bounded connected spaces; distinct from small cast, low budget or confinement as a plot event.
stakes.personal: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Consequences for an individual's life, identity, or goals.
stakes.relationship: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Consequences for a central relationship or small social unit.
stakes.community: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Consequences for a locality or community.
stakes.societal: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Consequences for institutions, a society, or civilization.
stakes.urgency: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Time pressure on consequential decisions or events.
dialogue.density: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Amount of spoken dialogue relative to the work's running time.
dialogue.dependence: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Importance of understanding dialogue to follow the work.
dialogue.monologues: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of extended uninterrupted speeches.
dialogue.overlap: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of simultaneous or overlapping speech.
dialogue.naturalistic_delivery: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Conversational delivery resembling spontaneous everyday speech.
dialogue.theatrical_delivery: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Heightened, rhetorical, or explicitly performative speech.
aesthetics.gothic: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Ominous, decaying, or romantically macabre visual atmosphere.
aesthetics.noir: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Shadowed, morally uneasy visual and atmospheric treatment, independently of crime plotting.
aesthetics.retro: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Deliberately retrospective visual or sonic styling; not merely an older release.
aesthetics.minimalism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Reduction of visual, sonic, or formal elements.
aesthetics.stylization: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Departure from naturalistic presentation through a distinctive audiovisual treatment.
aesthetics.surrealism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Dreamlike or illogical relationships in presented images and events.
aesthetics.psychedelia: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Hallucinatory, distorted, or perceptually altered sensory treatment.
aesthetics.grotesquerie: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Emphasis on distorted, repulsive, or biologically unsettling forms.
aesthetics.camp: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Theatrical excess and conspicuous artifice with an invitation to enjoy that excess.
aesthetics.ironic_distance: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Presentation that invites distance from its apparent surface meaning.
aesthetics.intimacy: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Presentation fostering closeness to characters' private experience.
aesthetics.spectacle: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Emphasis on impressive scale, effects, and set pieces.
aesthetics.immersion: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Strength of the sensory sense of inhabiting the work's world.
aesthetics.lyricism: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Poetic, associative presentation through image, language, sound or rhythm; not a synonym for slow pacing.
aesthetics.transgression: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Perceptible aesthetic treatment that deliberately challenges taboos or conventions; do not infer a creator's private intent or equate explicit content alone with transgression.
visuals.vibrant_palette: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of strongly saturated colors.
visuals.muted_palette: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of restrained or desaturated colors.
visuals.warm_color: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Prominence of warm hues and lighting.
visuals.cool_color: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Prominence of cool hues and lighting.
visuals.low_key_lighting: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Predominance of dark lighting with selective illumination.
visuals.high_key_lighting: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Predominance of bright, evenly illuminated scenes.
visuals.high_contrast: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Strong contrast between light and dark regions.
visuals.long_takes: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Prominence of extended shots without cuts; method of capture is irrelevant.
visuals.handheld_motion: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Prominence of visibly handheld or unstable camera movement.
visuals.production_design_detail: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Density of expressive detail in constructed environments and props.
visuals.cutting_pace: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Perceived rate of shot changes and editing transitions: 0 means virtually no cuts, not low quality. Distinct from rate of plot events.
action.martial_arts_choreography: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Combat organized around recognizable or stylized martial arts movement.
action.grappling: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Combat involving holds, clinches, throws, or ground fighting.
action.blade_combat: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Combat involving swords, knives, or similar blades.
action.superpowered_combat: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Combat involving abilities beyond ordinary human capacities.
action.chases: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Pursuits presented as action sequences.
action.large_battles: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Combat involving many participants or military-scale engagement.
action.gritty_combat: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Combat presented as physically punishing, messy, and effortful.
action.stylized_violence: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Violence presented through conspicuously aestheticized movement or imagery.
action.realistic_violence: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Violence presented with plausible physical consequences and vulnerability.
horror_modes.possession: integer 0–10 (centrality) — A supernatural entity inhabits or takes control of a person as a horror mechanism. Explicitly excludes psychological dissociation, an alternate personality without supernatural inhabitation, ordinary manipulation or influence, and merely owning or using a magical object.
horror_modes.body_horror: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Transformation, violation, or instability of the body matters to the horror.
horror_modes.folk_horror: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Folk belief, ritual, landscape, or insular tradition matters to the horror.
horror_modes.cosmic_horror: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Human insignificance before incomprehensible forces matters to the horror.
horror_modes.psychological_horror: integer 0–10 (centrality) — Perception, mental distress, or internal instability drives the horror.
sound.design_prominence: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Expressive prominence of non-musical sound design; not a quality judgment.
sound.ambient_soundscapes: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of environmental sound to create atmosphere.
sound.silence: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Expressive use of silence or near silence.
sound.sparse_score: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Use of little or no non-diegetic score.
sound.audio_startles: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Abrupt sound events intended to startle.
sound.music_dependence: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Importance of music to emotional or narrative understanding.
sound.musical_numbers: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Prominence of song or dance sequences functioning as narrative expression.
ending.conflict_resolution: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Extent to which central dramatic conflicts receive an outcome; independent of happiness. Spoiler-sensitive.
ending.interpretive_openness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Extent to which the ending permits multiple interpretations. Spoiler-sensitive.
ending.emotional_closure: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Extent of emotional completion or release at the ending. Spoiler-sensitive.
ending.happiness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Positive emotional outcome for focal characters at the ending. Spoiler-sensitive.
ending.tragedy: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Loss, defeat, or suffering defining the ending. Spoiler-sensitive.
ending.bittersweetness: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Intertwined positive and painful outcomes at the ending. Spoiler-sensitive.
viewing_demands.sensory_intensity: integer 0–10 (intensity) — Strength and density of audiovisual stimulation.
